name: month_number
description: Map month numbers to English month names; matched controls copy month numbers.
generator_code:
import random,json,calendar
random.seed(0)
items=[]; controls=[]
for i in range(120):
 n=random.randrange(1,13); year=random.randrange(1990,2031)
 pre='Month names: 1 = January; 2 = February; 3 = March; 4 = April; '
 items.append({'prompt':pre+f'{n} =','answer':' '+calendar.month_name[n]})
 controls.append({'prompt':pre+f'The year is {year}; the month number is {n}; the year again =','answer':' '+str(year)})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':controls},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
